description: Update Cargo.toml files across the codebase to ensure conditional compilation features (like `hydrate`) are properly documented on docs.rs. Currently, functions behind feature flags don't appear in documentation because the required `#cfg` attributes aren't being picked up by docs.rs. Also standardize the formatting of Cargo.toml files for consistency.
functional_requirements: Add `package.metadata.docs.rs` configuration to all Cargo.toml files that need feature-specific documentation
Ensure the `hydrate` feature is included in docs.rs builds so `hydrate_*` functions appear in documentation
Standardize the ordering of sections in Cargo.toml files for consistency across the codebase
Verify that all conditional compilation features that should be documented are properly configured for docs.rs
